pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos Portrait with Her Hair Pulled Back and Hoop Earrings Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos tilts her chin up in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with her hair swept into a high ponytail and large hoops at her ears. Loose curls frame her face, and the doubled lines around her tank top leave a narrow band to color along the neckline.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval Wearing His Backward Baseball Cap and Leonida Tank Top Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval wears his backward baseball cap in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with the snap strap just above his eyebrows. His tank top spells out Leonida beneath a sun and two palm trees, echoing the palms that lean over the water behind him.

pages.title: GTA 6 Cover Art with Jason and Lucia in the Center and a Helicopter in the Upper-Left Panel Coloring Page
pages.description: This GTA 6 cover art printable coloring page pairs Jason and Lucia at the center with a helicopter in a separate panel at the upper left. Palm trees and a tiny skyline fit inside the giant VI above them, and a beach lifeguard tower stands beside the setting sun.

pages.title: GTA 6 Poster of Lucia and Jason Sitting on the Hood of a Classic Car Beneath the Palms Coloring Page
pages.description: In this GTA 6 poster-style printable coloring page, Lucia and Jason sit on the hood of a classic car beneath tall palms. One of Lucia’s lace-up sneakers rests just above the grille, and a Ferris wheel rises over the water beyond Jason’s shoulder.

pages.title: GTA 6 Illustrated Map of Leonida Showing Vice City, the Grassrivers Marshes and the Leonida Keys Coloring Page
pages.description: An illustrated map of Leonida fills this GTA 6 printable coloring page, from the Grassrivers marshes to the Vice City waterfront and the Leonida Keys. An airboat and an alligator share a marsh channel, while a long bridge curves past palm-covered islands near the bottom of the map.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia Wearing Bandanas Outside the Xero Gas Station Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason and Lucia wear paisley bandanas over their faces in this GTA 6 printable coloring page set outside the Xero gas station. The pointed scarves have small teardrop shapes to color, while the broad canopy behind the pair carries the Xero name above a single visible gas pump.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vice City Sign with the Giant VICE Letters on Their Steel Frame Coloring Page
pages.description: The giant VICE letters tower above the shoreline in this GTA 6 printable coloring page of the Vice City sign. Bolts and diagonal braces divide the steel frame into smaller sections, and a low bridge and distant buildings are visible through the gaps beneath the lettering.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vice City Skyline with Waterfront Towers and the Ferris Wheel Across the Bay Coloring Page
pages.description: Look across the bay toward the Vice City skyline in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, where a Ferris wheel stands at the foot of two rounded towers. A speedboat trails a wake across the open water, and a palm frond hangs into the view from the upper left.

pages.title: GTA 6 Trailer 2 Artwork of Lucia Carrying a Metal Case as She and Jason Step Onto the Dock Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia carries a metal case onto the dock in this GTA 6 Trailer 2 printable coloring page, with Jason following one step behind. The case has twin latches and reinforced corners, and a floatplane rests on the water beyond the dock planks and wooden posts.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos in Her Prison Uniform Walking Through Leonida Penitentiary Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos walks through Leonida Penitentiary in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, wearing a short-sleeved prison uniform with a single chest pocket. Two figures walk away along a chain-link fence, and the prison name appears in outlined letters above the barred windows to Lucia’s left.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos Wearing a Lace Dress Beneath Her Leopard-Print Coat Coloring Page
pages.description: A leopard-print coat frames Lucia Caminos and her lace dress in this GTA 6 printable coloring page set against a beachfront skyline. Lucia rests both hands at her waist, leaving the large spots on her sleeves and the small flowers along the dress’s scalloped hem in view.

pages.title: GTA 6 Lucia Caminos on Her Motorcycle Beneath the Liquor Bar Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: Lucia Caminos sits astride her motorcycle in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with both hands on the handlebars beneath the Liquor Bar sign. A round headlamp faces forward between two rearview mirrors, and the sign’s outlined letters provide another area to color above the striped awning.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval's Vapid Ganado Lowrider Pickup with Its Long Hood and Open Truck Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason Duval leans against his Vapid Ganado lowrider pickup in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, arms folded above the truck’s long hood. The grille carries an oval Vapid badge beside the stacked headlights, and the open truck bed sits low beneath the palms along the waterfront.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason Duval Repairing the Roof of His House in the Leonida Keys Coloring Page
pages.description: On this GTA 6 printable coloring page, Jason Duval kneels on the roof of his Leonida Keys house with a claw hammer in one hand. He steadies a nail against a shingle with the other hand, his tool pouch at his hip and a palm tree rising behind his backward cap.

pages.title: GTA 6 Cal Hampton with His Putter Beside the Giant Alligator on the Mini Golf Course Coloring Page
pages.description: Cal Hampton rests both hands on his putter in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, grinning beside a giant alligator on the mini golf course. A ball sits near his sneakers, and the flag marks the hole in front of the alligator’s wide mouth and pointed teeth.

pages.title: GTA 6 Boobie Ike in Sunglasses and Gold Chains Beneath the Jack of Hearts Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: Boobie Ike wears rectangular sunglasses and two gold chains in this GTA 6 printable coloring page set outside the Jack of Hearts. His initials hang from the longer chain, and the club’s name stretches across the curved sign above his braids, with a heart centered over the lettering.

pages.title: GTA 6 Dre'Quan Priest at the Mixing Desk in the Only Raw Records Studio Coloring Page
pages.description: Dre'Quan Priest works the mixing desk at Only Raw Records in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with one hand on a fader and the other on a knob. A track display sits beside a studio speaker, and a microphone with a round pop filter hangs above the console.

pages.title: GTA 6 Real Dimez Rappers Bae-Luxe and Roxy Dancing on a Car at a Street Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Real Dimez rappers Bae-Luxe and Roxy dance on a car hood in this GTA 6 printable coloring page as a street party gathers around them. One bends her knees with her hands on her thighs and a butterfly pendant at her neck, while the other lifts both arms above her backward cap.

pages.title: GTA 6 Raul Bautista Standing at the Helm of a Yacht with Vice City Behind Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Raul Bautista grips the wheel of a yacht in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with Vice City’s waterfront just beyond the rail. Palm trees line the shore behind him and repeat across his open-collar shirt, where two chains hang above the large buttons.

pages.title: GTA 6 Brian Heder in a Tropical Shirt at His Leonida Keys Boatyard Coloring Page
pages.description: This GTA 6 printable coloring page catches Brian Heder at his Leonida Keys boatyard, with sunglasses on his head and a bottle in his hand. Large hibiscus blooms cover his open shirt, and a motorboat rests on supports beside a shed with a hose coiled on the wall.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vice Beach Lifeguard Tower Overlooking Beach Umbrellas and Swimmers Coloring Page
pages.description: The Vice Beach lifeguard tower fills this GTA 6 printable coloring page, from the crossed braces under its deck to the life ring on the railing. Beyond the stairs, two swimmers stand in the water near a pair of beach umbrellas, and a small plane flies above the distant skyline.

pages.title: GTA 6 Ocean View Hotel with Its Art Deco Entrance and Neon Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: The Ocean View Hotel’s neon sign curves around its Art Deco entrance in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with palms framing the stepped facade. Jason and Lucia stand beside a car at the foot of the steps, just below the wide marquee with the hotel’s name in outlined letters.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vapid Stanier '55 Sedan with Its Two-Tone Body and Wide Chrome Grille Coloring Page
pages.description: The Vapid Stanier ’55 faces the viewer at an angle in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, showing off its wide chrome grille and round headlights. A narrow strip of trim divides the two-tone body into long panels, with palm trees and a lifeguard tower along the waterfront behind the sedan.

pages.title: GTA 6 Leonida Keys with a Long Highway Bridge Linking the Islands Coloring Page
pages.description: A long highway bridge links the islands of the Leonida Keys in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, sweeping across open water toward a distant shore. Streetlights follow the bend above a row of bridge piers, and a small house on stilts stands among the palms across the water.

pages.title: GTA 6 Starlet Motel in Port Gellhorn with Its Roadside Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: A starburst tops the Starlet Motel’s roadside sign in this GTA 6 printable coloring page set in Port Gellhorn. The curling script and block letters leave room for different colors, and across the empty parking lot an outdoor staircase leads to a second row of motel doors.

pages.title: GTA 6 Grassrivers Fishing Village with Stilt Houses and a Water Tower Above the Marsh Coloring Page
pages.description: In this GTA 6 printable coloring page, a water tower rises over the stilt houses and wooden docks of a Grassrivers fishing village. A net hangs over the nearest porch rail, an airboat sits alongside a dock, and a long-legged bird wades among patches of marsh grass.

pages.title: GTA 6 Allied Crystal Sugar Refinery Rising Above the Cane Fields in Ambrosia Coloring Page
pages.description: This GTA 6 printable coloring page looks across the cane fields of Ambrosia toward the Allied Crystal sugar refinery, its name outlined on a tall storage tank. The long, arching cane leaves fill the foreground, while pipes link the tanks and a plume curls from one of the smokestacks.

pages.title: GTA 6 Mount Kalaga National Park with a Winding Canyon Road Between the Wooded Ridges Coloring Page
pages.description: Follow the winding canyon road into Mount Kalaga National Park on this GTA 6 printable coloring page, past a roadside sign with a mountain emblem. A guardrail traces the bends between steep rock faces, and the outlines of evergreens grow smaller along the ridges in the distance.

pages.title: GTA 6 Thrillbilly Mud Club with a Lifted Truck Sending Mud Over Its Wheel Arches Coloring Page
pages.description: A lifted pickup throws mud over its wheel arches on this GTA 6 printable coloring page set at the Thrillbilly Mud Club. The high suspension exposes the front axle and coil springs between the tires, and a wooden sign carries the club’s name in large outlined letters.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vice City Car Meet with Custom Lowriders and Motorcycles Beneath a Mural-Covered Overpass Coloring Page
pages.description: Two custom lowriders and a pair of motorcycles gather beneath a Vice City overpass in this GTA 6 printable coloring page. Flames run along the raised convertible and the nearest bike’s gas tank, while a mural of a woman with a flower in her hair covers one of the bridge columns.

pages.title: GTA 6 Grotti Cheetah '95 with Its Pop-Up Headlights Raised Outside Pegassi Residences Coloring Page
pages.description: Both pop-up headlights are raised on the Grotti Cheetah ’95 in this GTA 6 printable coloring page outside Pegassi Residences. The car’s low hood leaves a broad space to color between the lamps, with narrow vents along its side and curved balconies above the building’s entrance.

pages.title: GTA 6 Pegassi Infernus Classic Showing Its Wedge-Shaped Nose and Wide Rear Wing Coloring Page
pages.description: The wedge-shaped nose of the Pegassi Infernus Classic fills the foreground of this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with its wide rear wing visible above the roof. Narrow side vents break up the body panels, and an arched bridge leads across the water toward a skyline of tall buildings.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vapid Dominator Buggy with Its 1967 Fastback Body and Oversized Off-Road Tires Coloring Page
pages.description: The Vapid Dominator Buggy rides high on oversized off-road tires in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with a hood scoop on its 1967 fastback body. Four round lights line the front bumper above a slotted skid plate, and the deep tread blocks stand out against the bare dirt track.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vice Beach Police Cruiser with Marked Doors and a Rooftop Light Bar Coloring Page
pages.description: A Vice Beach Police cruiser sits beside the beach in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with a rooftop light bar and bold lettering on its doors. A palm emblem marks the rear door, while a flagged lifeguard tower and a rounded Art Deco building frame the street behind it.

pages.title: GTA 6 Police Cruisers Chasing a Pickup Down a Muddy Grassrivers Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Two Leonida Police cruisers chase a pickup along a muddy Grassrivers trail in this GTA 6 printable coloring page. The passenger points ahead as the truck’s front wheel throws up spray, and just beyond the splashes an alligator peers out of the water near a cluster of lily pads.

pages.title: GTA 6 Dinka Enduro Dirt Bike Parked Outside Jason's Garage Coloring Page
pages.description: The Dinka Enduro dirt bike rests on its kickstand outside Jason’s garage in this GTA 6 printable coloring page. Its knobby front tire, spokes and brake disc are all in view, while Jason leans against the doorway with his arms crossed beside shelves holding a toolbox and fuel can.

pages.title: GTA 6 Grassrivers Airboat with a Caged Propeller Skimming Through Tall Sawgrass Coloring Page
pages.description: A Grassrivers airboat skims through tall sawgrass in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, its low bow throwing spray as the driver grips the steering bar. His passenger sits just ahead of the huge caged propeller, while a long-legged bird flies over the palms on the far bank.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jet Ski Banking Past a Boat Party in the Leonida Keys Coloring Page
pages.description: Two jet ski riders bank past a boat party in the Leonida Keys on this GTA 6 printable coloring page. The woman at the handlebars leans into the turn as her passenger holds on, while partygoers raise their cups against a backdrop of palms and a long, low bridge.

pages.title: GTA 6 News Helicopter Above the Forested Slopes of Mount Kalaga Coloring Page
pages.description: A news helicopter flies above Mount Kalaga on this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with a reporter holding a microphone beside the pilot. A camera hangs beneath the rounded nose, and far below the landing skids, a narrow antenna rises from a rocky summit surrounded by forest.

pages.title: GTA 6 Alligator Walking Through the Open Door of a Convenience Store Coloring Page
pages.description: An alligator steps through a convenience store door on this GTA 6 printable coloring page, planting one clawed foot on the tiles beside the snack shelves. The view from inside catches the scales along its back, its open jaws, and the palms and city skyline beyond the doorway.

pages.title: GTA 6 Flock of Flamingos Lifting Off Over the Grassrivers Wetlands Coloring Page
pages.description: Six flamingos take flight over the Grassrivers wetlands in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, with one large bird spreading its wings across the center. Its long legs trail just above a splash among the lily pads, and the round propeller cage of an airboat stands out beyond the reeds.

pages.title: GTA 6 Dolphins Surfacing Beside the Squalo Speedboat with Jason and Lucia on Deck Coloring Page
pages.description: Two dolphins surface beside the Squalo speedboat in this GTA 6 printable coloring page featuring Jason and Lucia out on the water. Jason steers while Lucia holds the rail and rests an arm on his shoulder, just above the boat’s sloping bow and the curling splashes around the dolphins.

pages.title: GTA 6 Iguana Basking on a Rock with a Leonida Keys Island in the Distance Coloring Page
pages.description: An iguana basks on a rock in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, its head raised against the outline of a distant Leonida Keys island. Its curved claws and pointed spines fill the foreground, while two small houses stand on stilts across the water.

pages.title: GTA 6 Paddler in a Crest Kayak Approaching a Railroad Bridge in Mount Kalaga National Park Coloring Page
pages.description: A paddler in a Crest kayak approaches a railroad bridge in Mount Kalaga National Park on this GTA 6 printable coloring page. Seen from behind, she holds her double-bladed paddle across the kayak, with one blade dipping into the river and the bridge’s crisscrossed steel beams ahead.

pages.title: GTA 6 Plane Towing the NINE1NINE Nightclub Banner Along Vice Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: A small propeller plane tows the NINE1NINE nightclub banner along Vice Beach on this GTA 6 printable coloring page. The banner’s big outlined letters stretch across the sky above two beachgoers, with a raised lifeguard tower, a row of umbrellas and waterfront buildings farther down the shore.

pages.title: GTA 6 Bravado Banshee Roadster with a Racing Stripe Running the Length of Its Hood Coloring Page
pages.description: The Bravado Banshee roadster faces the viewer in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, its racing stripe running from the windshield down over the front bumper. Both seats show above the long hood, and the open spokes of the front wheel echo the gaps between the bridge piers in the distance.

pages.title: GTA 6 Jason and Lucia in an Open Convertible with a Yacht and Ferris Wheel Across the Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Jason takes the wheel and Lucia leans back beside him in an open convertible on this GTA 6 printable coloring page. Across the water, a yacht with round portholes sits in front of a Ferris wheel that rises above the palm-lined shore.

pages.title: GTA 6 Vice City Drawbridge with Its Two Spans Raised Over the River Coloring Page
pages.description: Both spans of the Vice City drawbridge stand raised above the river in this GTA 6 printable coloring page, framing a narrow view of the skyline. A speedboat cuts across the foreground in front of the matching bridge towers, and a helicopter flies past a bank of clouds.
